name: One Time Password
description: TOTP/HOTP two-factor authentication (RFC 4226 / RFC 6238) using an authenticator app, integrated into Drupal's login, one-time-login and REST login flows.
project_description: One Time Password is an opinionated, lightweight, near zero-configuration module that adds Time-based One-time Password (TOTP, RFC 6238) two-factor authentication to Drupal accounts. Users scan a QR code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, Duo Mobile, etc.) and are then prompted for a 6-digit code during login. The shared secret is stored on the user entity as an otpauth:// provisioning URI via the spomky-labs/otphp library; QR codes are rendered with endroid/qr-code. It hooks the standard login form, the one-time-login (password reset) link flow, and the REST user-login endpoint (X-OTP header), with per-user and per-IP flood control and TOTP window replay protection. The 2.x branch adds a single configuration option to force all authenticated users to enable 2FA. There are no recovery/backup codes in this branch.
